acceptance_criteria: New file overlayAlarmBridge.ts at repo root. Public API (default export object): fireOverlayAlarm(taskId:string, taskTitle:string): Promise<{fired:'overlay'|'unavailable'|'permission_denied'}>; dismissOverlayAlarm(taskId:string): Promise<void>; onAlarmAction(listener:(e:{taskId:string, action:'done'|'postpone'|'reroll'}) => void): () => void (returns unsubscribe). Implementation: lazy require('react-native').NativeModules.OverlayAlarm — caches null result so subsequent calls don't re-require; if module absent, fireOverlayAlarm returns {fired:'unavailable'} + console.warn once; if module.fireOverlayAlarm rejects with code 'ERR_OVERLAY_NOT_GRANTED', returns {fired:'permission_denied'}. onAlarmAction: when native module present, wraps NativeEventEmitter(NativeModules.OverlayAlarm).addListener('overlayAlarmAction', ...); when absent, subscribes to an internal listener set that __emitOverlayAlarmAction can drive. Mirrors the structural pattern of nativeAppControl.ts (getRawNative caching + test overrides). Exports a TypeScript OverlayAlarmAction type for consumers.

title: Phase 12 — OverlayAlarmService.kt: foreground service + WindowManager overlay
acceptance_criteria: New file android/app/src/main/java/com/anonymous/randomtime/overlayalarm/OverlayAlarmService.kt. Extends android.app.Service. onStartCommand handles two intent actions: ACTION_FIRE_OVERLAY (extras: taskId String, taskTitle String) which posts a foreground notification in a dedicated 'overlay_alarm_service' channel and inflates a WindowManager overlay via TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY with flags FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE|FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN|FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON, gravity BOTTOM|CENTER_HORIZONTAL; and ACTION_DISMISS_OVERLAY which removes the view silently. Overlay layout built programmatically in Kotlin (no XML) — LinearLayout(VERTICAL) with a TextView for the task title (bold, ~18sp) and a horizontal LinearLayout of three Buttons: 'Done', 'Postpone', 'Re-roll'. Any button tap: sends a LocalBroadcastManager (or context-registered) broadcast with action com.anonymous.randomtime.OVERLAY_ALARM_ACTION and extras {taskId, action:'done'|'postpone'|'reroll'}, then removes the view and calls stopSelf(). Returns START_NOT_STICKY (one-shot alarm). onDestroy removes the view if still attached and unregisters the notification. Runs on API 26+ (foreground services require channel); guards startForeground call with foregroundServiceType=specialUse on API 34+.
